agents.name: Defect Triage & Classification Agent
agents.purpose: Analyze incoming automated failure logs, stack traces, and test results to propose initial severity, affected subsystem, and potential duplicate defects.
agents.boundaries: Proposes triage draft only. Strictly prohibited from closing defects, changing severity without human sign-off, or assigning bug to live vendor queue.

outputSchema.rootCauseHypothesis: NullPointerException on unhandled 504 gateway response header
outputSchema.humanActionRequired: Review duplicate candidate and confirm priority before developer assignment

agents.escalationTrigger: Any defect with potential customer data exposure or payment gateway discrepancy escalates immediately to Test Manager.

agents.name: Requirements Decomposer & Test Design Agent
agents.purpose: Extract explicit business rules and acceptance criteria from Jira user stories to draft boundary, equivalence partition, and negative test scenarios.
agents.boundaries: Generates draft test specs. Must flag any unstated assumptions as 'Clarification Required'. Cannot approve test coverage.

ambiguitiesFlagged: AC does not define behavior when passport expiry is exactly today
outputSchema.humanActionRequired: Confirm flagged boundary with Business Analyst before adding to test suite

agents.escalationTrigger: Contradictions between OpenAPI contract and BRD acceptance criteria.

agents.name: Traceability & Coverage Audit Agent
agents.purpose: Scan repository test files and test management runs to audit end-to-end traceability from BRD requirements to automated test results.
agents.boundaries: Read-only auditor. Highlights unmapped requirements and orphan test scripts.

outputSchema.humanActionRequired: Approve updated RTM and schedule missing tests for sprint backlog

agents.escalationTrigger: Critical regulatory requirement found with 0 passing test evidence.
